sections.title: What *we do*

items.title: Public warehousing
items.text: Flexible storage that scales with your seasons and overflow, with no capital investment.

items.title: Contract warehousing
items.text: Dedicated space under an agreement from months to years, which can include handling, packaging and shipping.

items.title: Container breakdown
items.text: We pick up customs-cleared containers, unload, sort, repalletize, shrink-wrap and send them on.

items.title: Inventory management
items.text: Storage, shipping and tracking planned together, so inventory moves efficiently.

items.title: Packaging & kitting
items.text: Kitting, pick & pack, display assemblies, shrink wrapping, bagging and seasonal rework.

items.title: Transportation
items.text: LTL freight, dock drop and pick-up, freight redirection and sort services.

items.title: We pick it up
items.text: Once your container clears customs, we arrange insured transport to our Aiken warehouse.

items.title: We unload and inspect
items.text: Goods are verified, and any damage from shipping is caught early.

items.title: We repalletize
items.text: Cartons or drums go onto new pallets and are shrink-wrapped, packed to your specifications.

items.title: We deliver
items.text: Transport to your customer or your own site, with proof of delivery by fax or email.

items.q: Public or contract warehousing: what’s the difference?
items.a: A public warehouse stores inventory for many businesses, so you pay only for the space you use and can scale with demand. Contract warehousing gives you dedicated space and services under an agreement that can run from months to years.
Yes. Once a container clears customs we can pick it up, break it down and ship the goods on. We can also package, crate and brace items going overseas.
Through our network of local, regional and national trucking partners, anywhere in North America.
Visit our main office at 285 Main Drive in Aiken to apply in person.
